metadata.title: Acme Health Patient Intake API - GRC-Governed

components.title: Acme Health Patient Intake API
components.description: The CGE-P capstone starter's Patient Intake API (VPC, Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3), wrapped with a Terraform GRC baseline (customer-managed KMS, Object Lock evidence vault, CloudTrail, gap-closing hardening), an OPA/Rego policy gate, and a signed GitHub Actions evidence pipeline. Closes 7 of the 8 named gaps in GAPS.md against the HIPAA Security Rule (GAP-06 excluded: no HIPAA control citation).
components.purpose: Ingest and store patient intake submissions in an audit-defensible way.

control-implementations.description: Implementation of the 5 HIPAA Security Rule controls this capstone's Rego policy suite enforces, mapped to the 7 gaps closed in terraform/hardening.tf, kms.tf, and main.tf.

implemented-requirements.description: GAP-07: the intake Lambda's IAM policy is scoped to the exact actions handler.py calls (dynamodb:PutItem, s3:PutObject), not the wildcard dynamodb:*/s3:* the starter shipped with. Enforced by policies/gap07_iam_least_priv_aws.rego.

links.text: Signed pipeline evidence bundle from grc-gate.yml CI run 33582393841 (the merge-triggered apply-on-merge run for PR #1). Verified locally with scripts/verify-evidence.sh: SHA-256 match, Cosign signature valid against the public Sigstore log, Object Lock retention active. Output: CHAIN INTACT.

implemented-requirements.description: GAP-01/GAP-02: the S3 uploads bucket and DynamoDB submissions table are both encrypted with a customer-managed KMS key (rotation enabled), not AWS's default AWS-owned key. Enforced by policies/gap01_s3_kms_aws.rego and policies/gap02_dynamodb_kms_aws.rego.

implemented-requirements.description: GAP-08: API Gateway access logging is enabled, writing to a dedicated CloudWatch log group. CloudTrail additionally provides account-wide management-event audit logging. Enforced by policies/gap08_apigw_logging_aws.rego.

implemented-requirements.description: GAP-03: the S3 uploads bucket denies any request not made over TLS. GAP-05: the intake Lambda runs inside the starter's private subnets, reaching S3 and DynamoDB via VPC Gateway Endpoints so PHI traffic never traverses the public internet. Enforced by policies/gap03_s3_tls_aws.rego and policies/gap05_lambda_vpc_aws.rego.
